tasks.title: default.vue 레이아웃에 QDrawer 통합
tasks.description: 기존 레이아웃에 수직 메뉴 drawer 추가 및 반응형 설정
tasks.details:
layouts/default.vue 수정:
```vue
<template>
  <q-layout view="lHh Lpr lFf">
    <!-- Vertical Menu Drawer -->
    <q-drawer
      v-model="menuState.isOpen"
      :width="menuState.miniMode ? 60 : 280"
      :mini="menuState.miniMode"
      :breakpoint="1024"
      :overlay="$q.screen.lt.lg"
      :persistent="$q.screen.gt.md"
      bordered
      class="bg-grey-1"
    >
      <VerticalMenu />
    </q-drawer>

    <q-header elevated class="bg-primary text-white">
      <q-toolbar>
        <!-- Hamburger Menu Button -->
        <q-btn
          flat
          dense
          round
          icon="menu"
          @click="toggleDrawer"
          aria-label="Toggle menu"
        />

        <q-toolbar-title>
          {{ $route.meta.title || 'Nuxt Practice' }}
        </q-toolbar-title>

        <!-- Existing language switcher and user menu -->
        <q-btn-dropdown flat :label="locale.toUpperCase()">
          <q-list>
            <q-item clickable @click="setLocale('en')">
              <q-item-section>English</q-item-section>
            </q-item>
            <q-item clickable @click="setLocale('ko')">
              <q-item-section>한국어</q-item-section>
            </q-item>
          </q-list>
        </q-btn-dropdown>

        <q-btn flat round icon="person" @click="navigateTo('/profile')" />
      </q-toolbar>
    </q-header>

    <q-page-container>
      <slot />
    </q-page-container>
  </q-layout>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { useQuasar } from 'quasar';
import { useVerticalMenu } from '~/composables/useVerticalMenu';
import VerticalMenu from '~/components/navigation/VerticalMenu.vue';

const { locale } = useI18n();
const $q = useQuasar();
const { state: menuState, toggleDrawer } = useVerticalMenu();

const setLocale = (newLocale: string) => {
  locale.value = newLocale;
};
</script>
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. drawer가 화면 왼쪽에 올바르게 표시되는지 확인
2. hamburger 버튼 클릭 시 drawer 열림/닫힘 확인
3. 1024px 이상에서 persistent 동작 확인
4. 1024px 미만에서 overlay 동작 확인
5. mini mode 전환 시 drawer 너비 변경 확인
6. 기존 header 기능이 정상 작동하는지 확인
